OHLCV.description: Directly fetched from Binance public Kline feed with millisecond timestamps.

Volume & Quote Volume.description: Base volume and quote volume provided directly by exchange match engine.

Taker Buy/Sell Volume (True CVD Delta).description: Using Binance fields taker_buy_base_volume and taker_buy_quote_volume to compute exact taker delta.

RSI (Relative Strength Index).description: Wilder's smoothed RSI(14) using true historical gain/loss smoothing.

EMA / SMA.description: Standard exponential moving average with multiplier 2/(N+1) strictly without lookahead.

Level 2 Order Book Imbalance.description: Historical L2 order book depth is not captured in standard Kline REST API; any past claim of deep historical L2 in this environment was an estimation from volume and candle spreads.

Liquidation Stream.description: Historical spot Kline API does not include futures liquidation events.

Funding Rate.description: Spot Kline data does not contain perpetual swap funding rates.
